method: Actual production player SpriteView, registered Phaser AnimationState and animation events. Existing authored-arena fixture frozen; scene, Arcade world and game loop paused. Only actor Sprite.preUpdate and existing renderer are driven. Deterministic 20ms stepping and separate fresh-context RAF playback. No manual frame selection, private one-shot resets, production code changes or gameplay simulation.
limitations: Emulated Chromium viewports/DPR; presentation-only art evidence. Not live-combat, real-device, accessibility, performance or deployment validation. Video captures full viewport only on phone390 and desktop1280; RAF event clocks are actual callback times.
